name: Shenzhen Sunline Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Sunline Tech Co., Ltd. provides IT solutions and services for commercial banks and financial institutions in China and internationally. It provides core products, including core, bank loan, smart deposit, and cash management business systems; and digital products, such as digital core systems, digital financial business platforms, business middle office centers, open platforms, digital loan business systems, and unified payment platforms.
